title: Audit claim identity versus dedup representation

findings.failure: Same body_hash under a different predicate is an exact duplicate of the first live row.
findings.invariant: Structured claim identity is claim_key + polarity + normalized object; body prose is representation.
findings.evidence: verify-claim-identity.ts I5: employment.works_at then employment.role with identical body → outcome duplicate, same claim_id. RFC 0002 §4.3.1 states body_hash exact-dup; that collides with a different claim_key. Not covered by schema.test.ts:32-35 (different body).
findings.smallest_correction: P022/P032: exact occupancy should include claim_key (or refuse exact-dup when claim_key differs). Do not reuse Grace fixtures.

findings.failure: structuralMatch ignores validity overlap. Disjoint Northwind intervals corroborated as one row.
findings.invariant: Structural duplicate requires overlapping validity; disjoint intervals are two facts.
findings.evidence: I6 second insert outcome duplicate. claimsConflict already uses validityOverlaps and C2 passed.
findings.smallest_correction: Add validityOverlaps to structuralMatch; keep conflict path unchanged.

findings.location: packages/core/src/claims/store.ts:417-419 (findExact has no status predicate) vs schema.ts:501-504 (live-only unique index)
findings.failure: Re-extracting the original body after R3 supersession returns outcome duplicate of the superseded row (status=superseded).
findings.invariant: Exact identity must not occupy the live fact with a superseded/purged/skipped row.
findings.evidence: I8: third insert duplicate of 01CLAIMLINUS0000000000000E status superseded, object Northwind, after winner 01CLAIMLINUS0000000000000F rule R3.
findings.smallest_correction: Restrict findExact to status='live' (and matching origin checks), consistent with the unique index.

findings.failure: Same-event paraphrase increments corroboration; identical same-event refile does not.
findings.invariant: Re-extracting one event is duplicate observation, not independent support. Epistemic-integrity: confidence/corroboration must not rise from paraphrase of the same evidence.
findings.evidence: I1 corroboration stays 1 (exact path skips corroborate). I2 corroboration becomes 2 and original body is retained. Already asserted for Grace at packages/core/test/loop/dedup-threshold.test.ts:33-65. Two-event corroboration without supersession is already at provenance.test.ts:48-92.
findings.smallest_correction: Do not count structural matches that share the incoming event id as new corroboration. Do not duplicate the Grace test; add a same-event vs two-event matrix if P022 changes the rule.

findings.failure: Vector nomination cannot merge a different claim_key because structuralMatch requires the same key; liveByKey already loads that set.
findings.invariant: RFC 0002 §4.3.3: vector score nominates only. Semantic score is not an identity key.
findings.evidence: Static trace plus D3 score 0.8461538461538461 ≥ 0.82 on an independent 12-token pair. Existing Grace threshold tests remain the fixture-space proof (dedup-threshold.test.ts:21-31).
findings.smallest_correction: Keep scorer as nomination; do not treat Jaccard/hardcoded pairs as claim identity.

findings.failure: insertClaim duplicate does not union provenance; fileProposal does.
findings.invariant: One duplicate representation for ordinary claims.
findings.smallest_correction: P022/P032 pick one rule and document the other seam; do not assume they match.
